definitions.explanation: The activity of extinguishing and preventing fires.
The organization responsible for fighting fires.

examples.japanese: {消防|しょうぼう}{車|しゃ}がサイレンを{鳴|な}らして{走|はし}っていった。
examples.english: The fire truck drove by with its siren blaring.

examples.japanese: {消防|しょうぼう}{署|しょ}に{連絡|れんらく}してください。
{消防|しょうぼう}{士|し}は{命|いのち}がけで{火|ひ}を{消|け}す。
examples.english: Firefighters risk their lives to put out fires.

notes:
{消防|しょうぼう} is used as a prefix in many fire-related compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {消防|しょうぼう}{車|しゃ} (fire truck)
- {消防|しょうぼう}{署|しょ} (fire station)
- {消防|しょうぼう}{士|し} (firefighter)
- {消防|しょうぼう}{団|だん} (volunteer fire brigade)
- {消防|しょうぼう}{訓練|くんれん} (fire drill)
- {消防|しょうぼう}{設備|せつび} (firefighting equipment)

EMERGENCY NUMBERS:
- {火事|かじ}・{救急|きゅうきゅう}: 119 (fire/ambulance in Japan)
